calls.title: Phoenix Energy + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Phoenix Energy is undertaking a strategy to implement a structured A/B testing platform aimed at improving user experience and boosting conversion rates on their bondholder portal. The decision to adopt this experimentation platform stems from their growth goals, requiring data-driven validation of feature changes. Currently using Sentry for user session tracking, they acknowledge the absence of A/B testing capabilities. GrowthBook was evaluated alongside other platforms and was selected for its competitive pricing and data control features, appealing particularly to their regulated environment. The team emphasized the need for custom metrics to track user engagement and is exploring options for managed data warehousing to enhance their experimentation setup.
calls.keywords: bondholder portal, A/B testing, feature flags, warehouse-native, experimentation platform, metrics analytics
